preconditions.description: The number of glades n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The number of trails m is between 0 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in trails)
preconditions.description: Each trail connects glades numbered between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if all(degree % 2 == 0 for degree in degrees) and 1 in connected_components else return_value == 1
postconditions.description: The output is 0 if all glades have even degrees and glade 1 is in a connected component that includes all glades, otherwise the output is 1.
